gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, in the US, the Amazfit Bip 6 and Active Max can reply from the watch to WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Slack, Discord and similar chats on an iPhone. This works through Zepp Messenger with a free Beeper account. It is needed because Apple's notification service (ANCS) only lets a third-party watch send a 'positive' or 'negative' action, not a typed reply. iMessage and SMS replies stay impossible, because Beeper connects iMessage only on a Mac.
standout_why: Pages compared: our own page (says 'no message replies' and 'replying to messages… Android-only on Amazfit and Garmin'); The Gadgeteer under-$200 list (only 'message replies are also more limited than they are on Android' and 'the deeper message reply story is better on Android'); and ChatGPT's own answers built from the cited Amazfit, Tom's Guide and Yahoo pages ('generally cannot reply to iMessages'). None of them names Zepp Messenger or Beeper, the ANCS positive/negative-action limit, or the fact that the US workaround covers chat apps but not iMessage or SMS. The Tom's Guide and TechRadar pages came back truncated and the Yahoo page returned 403, so I could not confirm what they say about this.
decides: This confirms the Amazfit picks over the Garmin rows for an iPhone owner who wants to reply from the watch. The Bip 6 and Active Max are both on the Zepp OS 5 list that carries Zepp Messenger, so it doesn't separate the two Amazfit picks. The 'iPhone' column on our page needs fixing: change 'no message replies' to 'replies to WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and similar via Zepp Messenger and Beeper; no iMessage or SMS replies'. Apple's EU-only notification forwarding (iOS 26.5) doesn't reach a US shopper, and neither of our two picks is on Amazfit's list for it.

findings.label: What iOS lets a third-party watch do with an iPhone notification (ANCS)
findings.value: Only a 'positive action' or a 'negative action' that the iPhone defines (e.g. answer or decline a call). The spec has no reply or text-input action.
findings.note: Apple's wording: 'the NC can then request the NP to perform an action associated with a specific iOS notification'; flags are 'EventFlagPositiveAction' and 'EventFlagNegativeAction'; 'The actual actions performed by the NP on behalf of the NC are determined by the NP.' NC = the watch, NP = the iPhone.

findings.label: Amazfit's stated reason it needs a workaround for iPhone replies
findings.value: "Since Apple does not allow third-party wearables to reply directly to iOS notifications" Amazfit uses Zepp Messenger plus Beeper; requires Zepp app 9.13.0 or later
findings.source_title: How to Reply to iOS Message Notifications on Amazfit Bip 6 (ManualsLib copy)
findings.note: This is a ManualsLib copy of Amazfit's guide. The maker's own page (https://us.amazfit.com/pages/how-to-reply-to-ios-message-notifications-on-amazfit-devices) returned HTTP 429 three times. Setup: register with Beeper, connect chat apps, then in the Zepp app go to Device > Zepp Messenger > Matrix and sign in. To reply, tap the keyboard icon on a notification or use Zepp Flow voice.

findings.label: Software that carries iPhone chat replies
findings.value: Listed as compatible with Zepp OS 5, whose Zepp Messenger lets 'iOS users … reply to notifications from popular chat apps'; 'iOS notification replies require a valid Beeper account with connected chat apps'
findings.note: The page lists the chat apps: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Signal, Slack, Discord and Google Chat. It says SMS sending is for Android. iMessage is not mentioned.

findings.label: Software that carries iPhone chat replies
findings.value: Listed as compatible with Zepp OS 5 (Zepp Messenger: iOS chat-app replies via Beeper)
findings.note: The 12-model list: Cheetah 2 Ultra, Cheetah 2 Pro, T-Rex 3 Pro, T-Rex 3, T-Rex Ultra 2, Balance 2, Active 2 (Square), Active 2 (Round), Active Max, Active 3 Premium, Bip Max, Bip 6.

findings.label: Beeper cost
findings.value: Free, with an optional paid subscription (Beeper Plus)
findings.source_title: Beeper - One chat app for WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram & more
findings.note: The page states 'Beeper is free to use, with optional paid subscription.' It gives no price for Plus.

findings.label: iMessage through Beeper
findings.value: Mac only: 'iMessage is only offered for Mac'; 'You cannot connect iMessage from Beeper on another device'
findings.source_title: Beeper Help: New iMessage on macOS getting started guide
findings.note: The page also says iMessage chats 'will only live on the Beeper Desktop for Mac app'. Our inference: Zepp Messenger signs in to Beeper's Matrix service, so iMessage threads don't reach the watch, and iMessage and SMS replies from an Amazfit stay unavailable on iPhone.

findings.label: Apple's iOS notification forwarding to third-party watches (replies)
findings.value: EU only, iOS 26.5 or later, beta. Launch models: Cheetah 2 Ultra, Balance Ultra, Balance 3. Coming soon: Bip Max, Active 3 Premium, Cheetah 2 Pro, T-Rex 3, T-Rex 3 Pro, T-Rex Ultra 2, Balance 2
findings.source_title: Amazfit Brings Interactive iOS Notifications to Select Smartwatches in Europe (Zepp Health press release, June 25, 2026)
findings.note: The Bip 6 and Active Max are on neither list. A US shopper can't use this route, so Zepp Messenger with Beeper is the only US reply path on these watches.

findings.label: Apple's restriction before the EU change (named reviewer)
findings.value: Notebookcheck (Hannes Brecher, 2026-06-29): 'Apple had denied third-party smartwatches access to this feature'
findings.source_title: Notebookcheck: Amazfit takes on Apple Watch with deeper iPhone integration
findings.note: The article covers the EU notification-forwarding feature only and doesn't mention Zepp Messenger or Beeper.

unsourced: Amazfit's own US page on iOS replies (us.amazfit.com/pages/how-to-reply-to-ios-message-notifications-on-amazfit-devices), its device list and its wording. It returned HTTP 429 every time, so I used the ManualsLib copy and the Zepp OS 5 page instead.
Today's Amazfit US store prices for the Bip 6 and Active Max. storecheck.py and WebFetch both got HTTP 429. Price wasn't this angle, so I didn't try further.
Garmin's own support wording that text replies on the Forerunner 55 and Instinct 3 are Android only. support.garmin.com returned 403, and I didn't open Garmin's product pages or manuals for this.
Whether the Tom's Guide (cited), TechRadar and Yahoo Tech pages mention Zepp Messenger or Beeper. Tom's Guide and TechRadar came back truncated and Yahoo returned 403.
The Beeper Plus price, and whether Zepp Messenger changes the watch's battery life. Neither Beeper's home page nor the Zepp OS 5 page gives a figure.
